title: Server: auto-add the creator as a group member when a Group (GameSeries) is created from a game
description:
There is no `Group` model in this codebase -- "Group" (קבוצה) is `GameSeries`, membership is `SeriesParticipant` (role `MEMBER` | `MANAGER`, schema.prisma:581-591). Two code paths create a `GameSeries` "from a game" and neither inserts a `SeriesParticipant` row for the creator, so the creator is invisible in the members list (`GET /:seriesId` builds `subscribers` purely from `seriesParticipant.findMany`, server/routes/series.js:200-257) even though `GameSeries.organizerId` (schema.prisma:551) correctly identifies them for permission checks. Being listed with role `MANAGER` is sufficient -- the UI's existing "Manager" badge (mobile_app/app/series/[id].tsx:347-349, `role === 'MANAGER'`) already covers "shows they're the creator/admin"; no separate creator/organizer badge is needed.

1. In `createGame`'s recurring-creation branch, right after `const series = await prisma.gameSeries.create({...})` (gameService.js:687-704), insert:
```js
await prisma.seriesParticipant.upsert({
  where: { seriesId_userId: { seriesId: series.id, userId: creatorUser.id } },
  update: { role: 'MANAGER' },
  create: { seriesId: series.id, userId: creatorUser.id, role: 'MANAGER' },
});
```
Place it before the existing `const subs = await prisma.seriesParticipant.findMany(...)` read at line 706, so that read (used to seed `subscriberIds` for the generated occurrence games) already includes the creator.

2. In `convertGameToSeries` (gameService.js:1114-1227), right after `const series = await prisma.gameSeries.create({...})` (lines 1132-1150), insert the same upsert using `creatorUserId` (this function's param name, not `creatorUser.id`):
```js
await prisma.seriesParticipant.upsert({
  where: { seriesId_userId: { seriesId: series.id, userId: creatorUserId } },
  update: { role: 'MANAGER' },
  create: { seriesId: series.id, userId: creatorUserId, role: 'MANAGER' },
});
```
This must run unconditionally (not just inside the existing `if (copyParticipants) { ... }` block at lines 1152-1162, which only upserts participants copied from the source game's roster and defaults their role to `MEMBER`) -- place it before that `if` block so the creator always gets a `MANAGER` row regardless of `copyParticipants`.

Use the plain `prisma` client (module import from `server/lib/prisma.js`), matching the existing style in both functions at this point -- neither creation call is currently wrapped in a `prisma.$transaction`, so don't introduce one here; just mirror the surrounding code's client usage.

Do not change `server/routes/series.js`'s existing `/:seriesId/members` or `/:seriesId/subscribe` upsert patterns (lines 470-504, 267-289) -- they're already correct and are the pattern this task copies.

title: Mobile: fill in missing Hebrew/English translations for the group (series) management screen
description:
`mobile_app/app/series/[id].tsx` already calls `t('series.<key>', '<English default>')` throughout (it is not hardcoded), but 35 of its 37 distinct `series.*` keys are absent from both locale files, so they silently fall through to the literal English default text regardless of device language -- this is why group management shows English under a Hebrew-configured app. Only `series.customDates` and `series.loadingSeries` currently exist and work correctly. The existing `"series"` block is at he.json:433-446 and en.json:433-446 (do not touch its existing keys: badge, viewGroup, createGroup, weekly, customDates, weeklyBullet1-3, customDatesHint, customDatesWebHint, dayPrefix, loadingSeries).

Add Hebrew values (he.json) and correct English values (en.json, replacing the risk of relying on in-code fallback text) for these keys, matching each call site's English fallback text as the semantic source (tsx line numbers from research, for context only -- do not edit the .tsx file in this task):
`details` (162,178), `notFound` (181), `loadError` (52), `updateSuccess` (64), `updateError` (68), `deleteTitle` (76), `deleteConfirm` (77), `deleteSuccess` (86), `deleteError` (89), `inviteText` (99), `shareError` (103), `userNotFound` (117), `addMemberError` (124), `roleError` (137), `subscribeError` (151), `manageSettings` (214,435), `organizedBy`/`organizer` (238), `subscribed`/`subscribe` (298), `regulars` (310,331), `upcoming` (317), `schedule` (324), `manager` (348), `noRegulars` (361), `inviteMembers` (368), `shareInvite` (370), `searchUsers` (376), `add` (384), `upcomingGames` (392), `noGames` (421), `title` (442, this is the group-name field label, not the JSON key's own name -- pick a distinct key name if `title` collides with anything already in the `series` block), `description` (449), `defaultTime` (457), `updateFuture` (466), `delete` (490).

Write natural Hebrew phrasing for he.json (not a literal translation of the English placeholder text) consistent with this app's existing Hebrew tone (see other blocks like `settings`/`privacy` in the same file), and natural English for en.json. Follow each file's existing indentation/comma style exactly.

title: Server: add group-level defaults to GameSeries schema for settings that currently only exist per-game
description:
`GameSeries` (schema.prisma:549-579, the "Group") already stores `fieldId/fieldName/fieldLocation`, `price`, `maxPlayers`, `time`, `duration`, and `sport` as defaults for future games, but is missing several fields that `Game` (schema.prisma:283-341) has and that game-creation currently takes purely from the per-game request payload with no group-level default to fall back to: `isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `welcomeMessage`.

Add these fields to `model GameSeries` (schema.prisma:549-579), matching `Game`'s exact types/defaults (schema.prisma:289,298,301,303,309,291,314):
```prisma
isOpenToJoin       Boolean    @default(true)
isFriendsOnly      Boolean    @default(false)
joinPolicy         JoinPolicy @default(INSTANT)
lotteryEnabled     Boolean    @default(false)
organizerInLottery Boolean    @default(false)
teamSize           Int?
welcomeMessage     String?
```
`JoinPolicy` is an existing enum already used by `Game.joinPolicy` (schema.prisma:314) -- reuse it as-is, do not create a new enum.

From `server/`, run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_group_default_settings` (requires `DIRECT_DATABASE_URL`, never a `-pooler` hostname, per `.cursor/rules/prisma-db.mdc` and `server/docs/agents/database_rules.md`) so the migration SQL is generated under `server/prisma/migrations/`, then `npx prisma generate` so the local `@prisma/client` has these fields before tasks 4/5 write code against them. Do not touch any other model or enum in this file.

title: Server: apply group defaults for the new settings fields (and fix the sport fallback bug) when creating a game in a group
description:
Depends on task 3 (`prisma.gameSeries.<field>` must exist on the generated client). In `createGame`, when a game is created with a `seriesId`, several fields already fall back to the series' stored defaults when the caller leaves them unset -- see the pattern at gameService.js:600-609 (`time`, `duration`, `maxPlayers`, `price`). The fields added in task 3 (`isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `welcomeMessage`) do not get this treatment -- they're destructured directly from `payload` (gameService.js:527-557: `isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `joinPolicy` at their listed names; `welcomeMessage: rawWelcomeMessage`) and used as-is (or defaulted to a hardcoded value) in the `tx.game.create` data block at gameService.js:860-900, with no series fallback. Separately, `sport` (destructured directly, line 545) already exists as a `GameSeries` column but its fallback at line 897 (`sport: sport || 'SOCCER'`) skips the series entirely, going straight to the hardcoded default -- this is a real bug: an explicit `sport` chosen for the group is never applied to new games in it.

Mirror the existing pattern at lines 600-609: for each of the fields below, add a `const` right after that existing fallback block that uses the series value only when the caller left the field unset, keeping the payload value when the caller explicitly supplied one (including explicit `false`/`0`, which must NOT be treated as "unset"):
- `sport`: `const effectiveSport = (!sport && series) ? series.sport : (sport || 'SOCCER');` then use `effectiveSport` in place of `sport || 'SOCCER'` at line 897.
- `isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery` (booleans): `typeof X === 'undefined' ? (series ? series.X : <existing hardcoded default>) : X`, preserving each field's existing hardcoded default (line 870: `isOpenToJoin !== false` effectively defaults to `true`; 871: `!!isFriendsOnly` defaults `false`; 873: `!!lotteryEnabled` defaults `false`; 875: `!!organizerInLottery` defaults `false`) as the fallback-of-last-resort when there's no series either.
- `joinPolicy`: `typeof joinPolicy === 'undefined' ? (series ? series.joinPolicy : 'INSTANT') : (joinPolicy === 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL' ? 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL' : 'INSTANT')`, replacing the ternary currently inline at line 872.
- `teamSize`: `typeof teamSize === 'undefined' || teamSize === null || teamSize === '' ? (series ? series.teamSize : null) : parseInt(teamSize)`, replacing line 868's `teamSize ? parseInt(teamSize) : null`.
- `welcomeMessage` (the sanitized `welcomeMessage` local computed at line 564, not `rawWelcomeMessage`): fall back to `series.welcomeMessage` only when the raw payload value was empty/unset, mirroring how `description`/`title` are sanitized at lines 560-564 -- check `rawWelcomeMessage` before sanitization for emptiness, then use `series.welcomeMessage` pre-sanitization if so (it's already server-authored/trusted text from a prior create/update, sanitize it the same way as the rest if you route it through `sanitizeFreeText` again, that's fine and safer).

Update the `tx.game.create` data block (gameService.js:860-900) to use these new fallback-aware values instead of the raw destructured payload variables. Keep every other field in that block unchanged.

title: Server: persist and propagate the new group settings fields through the series update endpoint
description:
Depends on task 3. `PATCH /:seriesId` (server/routes/series.js:307-423) is the endpoint both the web `SeriesSettingsEditor` and mobile group-management screen use to edit group settings, with an `updateFutureGames` flag (default `true`) that also pushes changes onto already-created future `Game` rows in the same request (loop at lines 369-414). It currently whitelists `title, time, fieldId, fieldName, fieldLocation, price, maxPlayers, dayOfWeek, autoOpenRegistrationHours, description, imageUrl, duration` (destructured at lines 310-324) -- none of task 3's new fields (`isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `welcomeMessage`) nor the pre-existing `sport` column are accepted here at all.

1. Add `isOpenToJoin, isFriendsOnly, joinPolicy, lotteryEnabled, organizerInLottery, teamSize, welcomeMessage, sport` to the destructured `req.body` fields at lines 310-324.
2. Add corresponding `if (typeof X !== 'undefined') data.X = ...` lines to the `data` object build (lines 338-352), following the existing style per type: booleans (`isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`) as `data.X = !!X`; `joinPolicy` as `data.joinPolicy = joinPolicy === 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL' ? 'REQUIRES_APPROVAL' : 'INSTANT'`; `teamSize` as `data.teamSize = teamSize === null ? null : (Number.isNaN(Number(teamSize)) ? undefined : Number(teamSize))` -- guard so a bad value doesn't wipe it, skip assignment if NaN; `welcomeMessage` as `data.welcomeMessage = welcomeMessage === null ? null : String(welcomeMessage)`; `sport` as `data.sport = sport` (it's a `SportType` enum string, pass through as-is like the client already sends for `Game.sport`, no extra validation exists elsewhere in this file to mirror).
3. Add the same fields to the per-future-game `gd` object inside the propagation loop (lines 369-412), so `updateFutureGames: true` actually syncs these onto existing future games too, not just new ones created afterward -- this is the behavior the product ask ("do all these settings apply to future games, if not make them") is specifically about. Mirror the existing `if (typeof maxPlayers !== 'undefined' ...) gd.maxPlayers = ...` lines (373) for each new field, reusing the exact same conversion/guard logic as step 2 (e.g. `if (typeof isOpenToJoin !== 'undefined') gd.isOpenToJoin = !!isOpenToJoin;`).

Do not touch the `dayOfWeek`-blocked-for-WEEKLY logic (lines 332-336) or any other existing field's handling. Do not touch `schema.prisma` again in this task.

title: Web: add the missing group settings fields to the group settings editor
description:
Depends on task 5 (the `PATCH /:seriesId` endpoint must accept these fields before the UI can submit them). Today `SeriesSettingsEditor.tsx` (fields: `title` 78-84, `description` 88-96, `imageUrl` 100-108, field/venue 119-196, `time` 200-206, `duration` 209-217, `autoOpenRegistrationHours` 237-246, `updateFutureGames` toggle 250-259) and its backing hook `useSeriesSettingsEditor.ts` are missing editors for `maxPlayers`, `price`, `sport`, and all of task 3's new fields (`isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `welcomeMessage`) -- `maxPlayers`/`price`/`sport` already exist as `GameSeries` columns and were already usable server-side, they're just not exposed in this form. This is the admin-facing "edit all future-game defaults in one place" surface the product ask wants, so it must offer the same field set as per-game creation.

For the exact field types, option values, and enum strings to match (so the group editor and per-game creation form present identical choices), read `next_app/src/hooks/useGameCreator.ts:28-48` (its `form` state) and whatever component renders that form's `isFriendsOnly`/`joinPolicy`/`lotteryEnabled`/`organizerInLottery`/`sport`/`teamSize` inputs -- copy the same input type (toggle/select/number field) and the same option labels/values per field, don't invent new UI conventions.

1. In `useSeriesSettingsEditor.ts`, extend the editor's state shape and its submit payload builder to include `maxPlayers` (number), `price` (number), `sport` (select, same `SportType` enum options as the per-game form), `isOpenToJoin` (toggle), `isFriendsOnly` (toggle), `joinPolicy` (select: `INSTANT` | `REQUIRES_APPROVAL`), `lotteryEnabled` (toggle), `organizerInLottery` (toggle, only relevant/shown when `lotteryEnabled` is on -- mirror how the per-game form gates this), `teamSize` (number, optional/nullable), `welcomeMessage` (multiline text, optional/nullable). Initialize each from the series prop the same way `title`/`description` etc. already are.
2. In `SeriesSettingsEditor.tsx`, add form controls for all of the above, placed after the existing `duration`/`autoOpenRegistrationHours` fields (around line 246) and before the `updateFutureGames` toggle (250-259), using the same MUI components/spacing/labeling conventions as the surrounding fields. Use Hebrew labels consistent with the rest of this file's existing labels (this app's web UI text is written directly in Hebrew, not via an i18n layer).

Do not change the `updateFutureGames` toggle's behavior or wiring -- it already covers these new fields once task 5 lands, since it POSTs the whole form payload to the same endpoint.

title: Mobile: add the missing group settings fields to the mobile group management screen
description:
Depends on task 2 (this screen's existing `series.*` keys must already be localized before adding more to the same block) and task 5 (endpoint must accept these fields). Mirrors task 6 on web, for parity: today the mobile settings section (`canManage`-gated, mobile_app/app/series/[id].tsx:440-495) only edits `title` (442-448), `description` (449-455), `time`/"Default Time" (457-463), and the `updateFuture` toggle (465-473) -- missing `maxPlayers`, `price`, `sport`, and all of task 3's new fields (`isOpenToJoin`, `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `teamSize`, `welcomeMessage`).

Before writing UI, check the mobile per-game creation screen under `mobile_app/app/games/` (grep for its form state / field list, not yet inspected in research) for the exact input styles and enum option labels used per-game for `isFriendsOnly`, `joinPolicy`, `lotteryEnabled`, `organizerInLottery`, `sport`, `teamSize` -- the group editor must offer the identical set of choices as the per-game form, styled consistently with this screen's existing inputs (same rounded/border/bg-white text input conventions used by the current `description`/`time` fields at 449-463).

1. In `mobile_app/app/series/[id].tsx`, add editable controls for `maxPlayers` (number input), `price` (number input), `sport` (picker/select), `isOpenToJoin` (switch/toggle), `isFriendsOnly` (switch/toggle), `joinPolicy` (picker: instant vs. requires approval), `lotteryEnabled` (switch/toggle), `organizerInLottery` (switch/toggle, shown only when `lotteryEnabled` is on), `teamSize` (number input, optional), `welcomeMessage` (multiline text input, optional) -- placed in the same settings section, after the existing `time` field (463) and before the `updateFuture` toggle (465-473). Wire each into the same save handler that currently PATCHes `title`/`description`/`time` so they submit together.
2. Add new keys for every new label/option under the existing `"series"` block in both `he.json` and `en.json` (Hebrew primary text, matching this screen's existing tone; English secondary), following the same block/convention used by task 2's additions. Do not duplicate any key task 2 already added.
